description.value: A 92-site frontcountry campground on Highway 99 between Whistler and Pemberton, with a signed trail to a dramatic 60-metre waterfall on the Green River; amenities are solid but riverbanks are steep and the water is fast and cold.

raw_osm.name: Nairn Falls Campground
raw_osm.operator: Sea to Sky Park Services Ltd.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Nairn Falls Park is an active provincial frontcountry campground 20 minutes north of Whistler with 94 sites, matching the OSM capacity tag. A prominent 'Book camping' button on the park page and the general frontcountry reservations subpage confirm reservations are accepted. Food nearby is supported by the website stating the park is 'within the boundaries of the Village of Pemberton, just five minutes from Pemberton town center.' Most specific amenity details (showers, potable water, etc.) are absent from the fetched website content, so those fields remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: The Nairn Falls Trail explicitly states 'Mountain bikes are not permitted' — this applies to the specific hiking trail, not the campground or road access, but reviewers should note the distinction.
OSM phone number (+1-604-986-9371) is listed as the Sea to Sky Park Services operator line; the fetched website content does not explicitly display this number, so phone confirmation remains null.
OSM tag internet_access=no is consistent with BC Parks' general note that 'most parks lack internet connectivity,' but no specific in-camp charging infrastructure is mentioned.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established BC Parks provincial campground on a primary cycling corridor (Sea to Sky Highway / Duffey Lake Road) with online reservations and immediate proximity to Pemberton services; clearly valuable to touring cyclists as a confirmed overnight stop.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM sanitary_dump_station=no confirmed in OSM tags; not contradicted by website. OSM wheelchair=yes tag is noted but not independently confirmed in the fetched website content.
